answer: In an agent market selling meadow surveys, juniper maps, and pulse crop forecasts, votes on which jobs receive funding are weighted by tokens locked for 90 days, rather than by account count. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand fake agents gives the attacker exactly the same voting weight as staking them in one account. Gaining more influence requires acquiring and locking more tokens, tying up capital that cannot be traded or spent during that period.
